# An incremental protoc.generate compiles only the sources that changed or
# import a changed file, compiles new sources alone, and falls back to a
# full run that removes stale outputs when a source is deleted.
[!exec:protoc] skip
[!exec:protoc-gen-go] skip

bit
stdout 'gen ▶ protoc -I\. -Ishared --go_out=gen --go_opt=paths=source_relative api/\*\.proto$'
exists gen/api/a.pb.go gen/api/b.pb.go gen/api/c.pb.go

# Only b imports ids.proto.
cp ids.proto.changed shared/ids.proto
bit
stdout 'gen ▶ protoc .* api/b\.proto \('
stdout 'compiling 1 of 3 sources'

cp a.proto.changed api/a.proto
bit
stdout 'gen ▶ protoc .* api/a\.proto \('
stdout 'compiling 1 of 3 sources'
grep 'AExtra' gen/api/a.pb.go

cp d.proto.new api/d.proto
bit
stdout 'gen ▶ protoc .* api/d\.proto \('
stdout 'compiling 1 of 4 sources'
exists gen/api/d.pb.go

rm api/d.proto
bit
stdout 'gen ▶ protoc .* api/\*\.proto \('
! stdout 'compiling'
stdout 'gen ▶ rm gen/api/d\.pb\.go'
! exists gen/api/d.pb.go
exists gen/api/a.pb.go gen/api/b.pb.go gen/api/c.pb.go

bit
stdout 'gen · no changes'

-- BUILD.bit --
gen = protoc.generate {
  sources     = ["api/*.proto"]
  include     = [".", "shared"]
  out         = { go = "gen" }
  opt         = { go = "paths=source_relative" }
  incremental = true
}
-- api/a.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package api;
option go_package = "example.com/api";

message A {}
-- a.proto.changed --
syntax = "proto3";
package api;
option go_package = "example.com/api";

message A {}

message AExtra {}
-- api/b.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package api;
option go_package = "example.com/api";

import "ids.proto";

message B {
  Id id = 1;
}
-- api/c.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package api;
option go_package = "example.com/api";

message C {}
-- d.proto.new --
syntax = "proto3";
package api;
option go_package = "example.com/api";

message D {}
-- shared/ids.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
option go_package = "example.com/ids";

message Id {
  string value = 1;
}
-- ids.proto.changed --
syntax = "proto3";
option go_package = "example.com/ids";

message Id {
  string value = 1;
  int64 version = 2;
}
